description: Swift Package Index Submission: discover, prepare, submit, and evidence Swift Package Index publication for MCHSBind.
blocker: Deprecated and cancelled on 2026-07-03 by project governance. Historical Swift Package Index publication evidence is retained only; no further SPI work is planned unless re-chartered.

package_evidence.discovery_result: Live probes on 2026-06-12 found the PackageList issue closed as completed, a maintainer correction comment that the package was added with PR 13999, merged PackageList PR 13999, raw PackageList main containing https://github.com/edithatogo/mchs-swift.git, and the GitHub release v0.1.0 still published. A public Swift Package Index page probe with the checked-in registry probe user agent returned HTTP 200 and exposed MCHSBind, edithatogo/mchs-swift, stable v0.1.0, the SPM manifest snippet, and the GitHub release link.
package_evidence.submission_issue_live_result: GitHub API returned issue state=closed state_reason=completed closed_at=2026-05-24T11:07:11Z; maintainer comment on 2026-06-12 says the original issue was closed prematurely and the package was added with PR 13999.
package_evidence.packagelist_validation: Valid JSON checks succeeded and maintainer review was APPROVED by daveverwer.
package_evidence.test_note: swift test exits with no tests found because the package has no Tests target
package_evidence.fixed_publication_metadata: Added MIT LICENSE to the public package repo, set Swift package topics, and created GitHub release v0.1.0.
package_evidence.release_probe_result: GitHub release API returned tag_name=v0.1.0, name=MCHSBind v0.1.0, draft=false, prerelease=false, published_at=2026-05-25T13:03:45Z.
package_evidence.latest_public_probe: https://swiftpackageindex.com/edithatogo/mchs-swift returned HTTP 200 on 2026-06-12 with title MCHSBind - Swift Package Index, canonical edithatogo/mchs-swift links, stable v0.1.0, an SPM snippet using from: 0.1.0, and a release link to https://github.com/edithatogo/mchs-swift/releases/tag/v0.1.0.

support_scope.summary: Swift Package Index publication evidence remains retained as historical proof, but the Swift package surface is deprecated and cancelled and is not an active support or publication target.

gap_register.summary: SPI compatibility/build matrix processing is external to the publication claim and may lag after package listing.

cancellation_reason: Surface deprecated and cancelled; historical publication evidence retained only.
